description: Human-authored synthetic policies and task labels, frozen before retrieval. No provider answers or private source.

claims.statement: Payment retries must reuse the same idempotency key; generating a new key can charge twice.
A payment timeout has an unknown outcome; reconcile the payment before retrying.
Payment amounts are integer cents; floating point totals are prohibited.
Inventory reservations must be released when an order is cancelled.
Inventory decrements use a conditional update to prevent overselling under concurrent checkout.
Webhook signatures must be verified against the raw request body before JSON parsing.
Duplicate webhook events are ignored using the provider event identifier.
Database integration tests require Docker and an isolated fixture database.
Payment logs must omit customer contact fields and payment credentials.
Tests for payment inventory webhook database code should be readable and fast.
Payment retries generate a new idempotency key for every attempt.
Payment retries are disabled during the experimental gateway rollout.
Payment timeouts may be retried immediately without reconciliation.
Webhook signatures are optional for fixture requests.
Resume must target the confirmed native session UUID; never select the latest conversation.
Terminal reconnect must not replay input or reply to historical device queries.
Terminal output is bounded; lost history must produce a visible gap.
App shutdown terminates its terminal; restart offers explicit resume without automatically launching a provider.
Context receipts record submitted text, not model acknowledgment; interrupted delivery remains uncertain.
Changed evidence fingerprints exclude stale knowledge until a new revision is reviewed.
Branch knowledge cannot be supplied in another branch or checkout.
Native terminal development requires Node 24 and the Electron-native PTY module.
Terminal memory context tests code should be readable and maintainable.
Resume may select the latest conversation when the exact UUID is missing.
Terminal history is persisted in the experimental diagnostics branch.
Context receipts can infer acknowledgment from an assistant success message.
App shutdown leaves the provider running for implicit reconnect.
Database integration tests run manually on the local computer, without CI or nightly jobs.
